overviewParagraphs: Heron Lake Golf Course is one of Northern Vietnam's most naturally integrated playing experiences — a resort layout that respects and incorporates the region's native wetland ecosystem rather than fighting against it. Herons, egrets, and wildlife are constant companions throughout the round.

Designed by Brian Curley (Schmidt-Curley Design), the course flows seamlessly through the natural landscape with strategic water features and mature tree corridors framing each hole. The greens are undulating and receptive, rewarding approach shots hit with precision and appropriate trajectory.

Located within easy reach of Hanoi, Heron Lake is an excellent choice for the discerning golfer who wants a peaceful, countryside round in contrast to the busier resort circuits. Its combination of natural beauty and solid course design consistently earns it high marks from visiting internationals.

curatorBriefHtml: Heron Lake Golf Course (Dam Vac Golf & Country Club) in Vinh Phuc Province sits just 45 minutes northwest of central Hanoi and only 30 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport — making it one of the most convenient championship rounds in Northern Vietnam. Designed by Pacific Coast Design, the 6,971-yard Par 72 layout winds through natural freshwater wetlands and mature lakeside ecology that shelters local birdlife.

Unlike Hanoi’s mountain-ringed courses, Heron Lake is a flat, walking-friendly precision test where water comes into play on almost every hole. Generous Paspalum fairways invite confident tee shots, yet strategic doglegs, penal greenside bunkering, and swirling crosswinds off Dam Vac Lake demand disciplined iron play into well-protected greens.

Because of its rapid 30-minute transfer from Noi Bai Airport, Heron Lake is an ideal arrival-day or departure-day round on a Northern Vietnam golf tour — pairing smoothly with nearby Thanh Lanh Valley (25 minutes away) or BRG Legend Hill.

scorecard.verdict: A peaceful resort layout that blends harmoniously into the Heron Lake wetlands. Native water birds, palm-lined fairways, and strategic water hazards reward thoughtful shot placement.

faqs.q: How close is Heron Lake Golf Course to Hanoi's airport?
faqs.a: Heron Lake lies in Vinh Yen (Vinh Phuc Province), roughly 30 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) and 45–55 minutes from central Hanoi — making it one of the easiest courses to schedule on an arrival or departure day.

faqs.q: What style of golf course is Heron Lake?
faqs.a: Heron Lake is a flat, lakeside wetland parkland course designed by Pacific Coast Design (Par 72, 6,971 yards). Water hazards, natural lagoons, and deep greenside bunkers define the challenge rather than steep hills.

faqs.q: Which nearby courses pair best with Heron Lake?
faqs.a: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort sits just 25 minutes north in the Tam Dao foothills, making a two-course Vinh Phuc swing (wetland precision at Heron Lake + dramatic mountain golf at Thanh Lanh) an effortless pairing.

faqs.q: What months offer the best playing conditions at Heron Lake?
faqs.a: October through April brings pleasant 18–26°C northern temperatures and crisp turf conditioning. Early morning tee times work well year-round.
